mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cp_customer_employee_assignments assignment JOIN cp_customers linked_customer ON linked_customer.id = assignment.customer_id WHERE assignment.employee_user_id = u.id AND linked_customer.status = 'ACTIVE' AND linked_customer.party_role IN ('SHIPPER', 'CONSIGNEE')) AS linked_customer_count FROM cp_users u WHERE u.role = 'OVERSEA_AGENT' AND u.status <> 'DELETED' ORDER BY u.display_name, u.username, u.id

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cp_customers customer WHERE customer.responsible_agent_id = u.id AND customer.status = 'ACTIVE') AS customer_count FROM cp_users u WHERE u.role = 'BUSINESS' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY u.display_name, u.username, u.id
SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id, username, display_name, status FROM cp_users WHERE id = #{userId} AND role = 'OVERSEA_AGENT' AND status <> 'DELETED'
SELECT id FROM cp_users WHERE username = #{username}
mapper.update: UPDATE cp_users SET display_name = #{displayName}, status = #{status}, password_salt = #{salt}, password_hash = #{hash}, password_iterations = #{iterations}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{userId} AND role = 'OVERSEA_AGENT'
UPDATE cp_users SET display_name = #{displayName}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{userId} AND role = 'OVERSEA_AGENT'
UPDATE cp_users SET password_salt = #{salt}, password_hash = #{hash}, password_iterations = #{iterations}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{userId} AND role = 'OVERSEA_AGENT'

UPDATE cp_users SET username = #{username}, status = 'DELETED', password_salt = #{salt}, password_hash = #{hash}, password_iterations = #{iterations}, last_login_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{userId} AND role = 'OVERSEA_AGENT' AND status <> 'DELETED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cp_oversea_agent_shipment_scopes ( shipment_id, oversea_agent_customer_id, represented_customer_id, status, assigned_by, assigned_at, updated_at ) SELECT shipment_access.shipment_id, link.oversea_agent_customer_id, link.customer_id, 'ACTIVE', link.assigned_by, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) FROM cp_oversea_agent_customers link JOIN cp_customer_shipment_access shipment_access ON shipment_access.customer_id = link.customer_id WHERE link.customer_id = #{customerId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cp_oversea_agent_shipment_scopes WHERE represented_customer_id = #{customerId} AND shipment_id = #{shipmentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cp_oversea_agent_shipment_scopes ( shipment_id, oversea_agent_customer_id, represented_customer_id, status, assigned_by, assigned_at, updated_at ) SELECT shipment_access.shipment_id, link.oversea_agent_customer_id, link.customer_id, 'ACTIVE', link.assigned_by, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) FROM cp_oversea_agent_customers link JOIN cp_customer_shipment_access shipment_access ON shipment_access.customer_id = link.customer_id AND shipment_access.shipment_id = #{shipmentId} WHERE link.customer_id = #{customerId}
mapper.select: SELECT employee_user_id FROM cp_customer_employee_assignments WHERE customer_id = #{customerId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cp_customer_shipment_access WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND shipment_id = #{shipmentId}
